claim: Tier-2 doctrine selection reads as a visual command-deck choice rather than a dense settings form.
artifact_or_command: independent blind baseline/current three-state dual-size comparison with two corrective re-reviews

assertions: 8.4; full top bar, permanent status and equal command cards fit 568
8.4; hero identity and both complete choices retain equal visual weight
8.6; hero, chosen doctrine and active status read within two seconds

grader.name: independent doctrine command-deck blind visual critic

observation: Baseline scored 3.9 overall/3.4 minimum. First hero-led candidate still clipped at 568. After compact wrapping correction, final candidate scored 8.5 overall with 8.4 minimum and no clipped state.
inference: Candidate clears overall>=8 and every state>=7 after resolving both dashboard hierarchy and compact-width failures.
limitations: Dark flat command panels still rely partly on confirm copy for click affordance; 568 benefit text is near the comfort limit.
